service.description: The BOSS screen link (/qapps) and icon of a Mantle record, by its search document type or the record's full entity name (recordEntityName), its id and, for a work effort, its type (looked up when not given); a link of null when no app the user has has a screen for it. A project, and a task or a request in a project (rootWorkEffortId), open in IronStone Projects for a user who may open it (design-projects.md §1.4: an authorization of the user's groups on the Projects root, with no deny; a sprint, milestone or release opens its detail there), else a task or request in Commons and a project nowhere; a task or request with no project stays in Commons. A client contact (PROJECT_CLIENT) gets a link to a project, work item, milestone, release or request in Projects only (impl-projects.md P10). The Today panel, the notification lists and the palette use it.

parameter.name: docType
parameter.description: MantleParty, MantleTask, MantleEvent, MantleRequest, MantleProject, MantleWikiPage, MantleCommunicationEvent, MantleShipment, MantleAsset, MantleFacility, or MantleWorkEffort with workEffortTypeEnumId

parameter.name: recordEntityName
parameter.description: Instead of docType: mantle.party.Party, mantle.request.Request, mantle.work.effort.WorkEffort, moqui.resource.wiki.WikiPage, mantle.party.communication.CommunicationEvent, moqui.resource.GitMergeRequest or moqui.resource.GitRepository (Projects' Code), mantle.work.time.Timesheet (Projects' Time, else People's for a People user or a self-service employee; with docType MantleTimesheetWeek and a day as id the user's own week in My time, the same way), mantle.product.bom.ProductBom or mantle.work.production.WorkCenter (a run, operation, method, routing or work center opens under Manufacturing for its users), mantle.order.OrderHeader or mantle.party.agreement.Agreement (a purchase order, supplier quote or purchase agreement opens under Purchasing for its users; a sales order under Customer Service for its users), mantle.product.store.ProductStore (a store opens under Commerce for its users), moqui.security.DeviceCredential (a shared device opens Admin's Security › Devices for one who may read it there)

service.description: The palette's Records group: mantle.search.UniversalSearchServices.search#Universal over the docTypes, with its per-user and organization limits; each result to its BOSS screen (get#RecordLink), else the search's own link of the boss link set as a /qapps link. moreUrl is Commons/Search with the text. No rows without document types or a search backend.

The palette's People group (prefix @): the directory and the user's own personal contacts, through mantle.party.PartyServices.find#Party by name (organization, first or last name), or by email address when the text has an @; to Commons/Contacts/ContactDetail.

The palette's Pages and files group: org.moqui.resource.WikiServices.search#WikiPages (the search documents on WikiPage, MantleWikiPage, for the title and text when search is available, else the page paths), which leaves out the spaces and restricted pages the user may not view; another user's notes are left out too (an administrator may view them), the user's own notes are in. Each to Commons/Knowledge, a note to Commons/Notes. Files and drives join with M8.
The palette's Events group: the user's upcoming events (WetEvent starting from now) whose name has the text, the ones the user's party is on or owns, soonest first; to Commons/Calendar/EventDetail.

The palette's id lookup: mantle.GeneralServices.lookup#ById on the text (an id, a pseudo id, an external id), each record found that Commons or Comms has a screen for as a row: a party, a task or event, a request, a communication event. Under the Commons filters, as the lookup's own finds run.
